origins.section: 11.1 A Participant Test Gets Its Context From `IncomingListener`
11.3 Tests That Share a Q2 Share Its State
11.4 Only a Socket Test With the Terminals' Framing Tests `50_server.xml`
11.5 Only Two Transactions in Flight Show What Sessions Share

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-hand-built-key: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hand-built-key: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-hand-built-key: 11.1 says IncomingListener stores the request under "REQUEST" and a key matches only an equal key, so the participant reading "Request" finds nothing (option a).
recorded.prompt:q-reset-by-registering: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reset-by-registering: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reset-by-registering: 11.3 says the participant looked its totals up once in setConfiguration and still holds the first object, so registering a new one doesn't reach it (option a).
recorded.prompt:q-client-from-descriptor: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-client-from-descriptor: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-client-from-descriptor: 11.4 shows TestTerminal, which uses the channel the descriptor was copied with, shares its mistake and gets approved, and says to build the client from the network's specification and never from 50_server.xml (option a).
recorded.prompt:q-one-after-another: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-one-after-another: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-one-after-another: 11.5 says TerminalCheck's tests sent one request at a time and missed the bug, which shows up only when a second transaction writes the field while the first is still inside the participant (option a).

gates.says: all 12 of this quiz's discriminating readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-hand-built-key:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hand-built-key:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-hand-built-key:b: 11.1's Contexts helper calls listener.process and then takes the Context from the queue before any prepare runs, so the listener queues it first.
recorded.prompt:q-hand-built-key:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hand-built-key:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-hand-built-key:c: 11.1 states a key matches only an equal key, so no other spelling finds it, which rules out case-insensitive matching.
recorded.prompt:q-hand-built-key:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-hand-built-key:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-hand-built-key:d: 11.1 says the test and participant use the same wrong key and so agree, and the participant aborts with no response when given a real listener's Context.
recorded.prompt:q-reset-by-registering:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reset-by-registering:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reset-by-registering:b: 11.3 explains the stale counts entirely by the participant still holding the first object and only the test reading the new one, which leaves no role for copied counts (implied, not stated).
recorded.prompt:q-reset-by-registering:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reset-by-registering:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reset-by-registering:c: 11.3 says the @BeforeEach registration replaces the registered object, so the registry does not refuse it.
recorded.prompt:q-reset-by-registering:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-reset-by-registering:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-reset-by-registering:d: 11.3 says the NameRegistrar is static, one per JVM, and later test classes in the same JVM see its entries, so it is not per class.
recorded.prompt:q-client-from-descriptor:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-client-from-descriptor:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-client-from-descriptor:b: 11.4 shows a socket client with the wrong framing failing at the channel (EOFException, Invalid message length), so a socket test does exercise the channel.
recorded.prompt:q-client-from-descriptor:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-client-from-descriptor:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-client-from-descriptor:c: 11.4 shows TestTerminal answered over a real socket while the real terminals' NACChannel client was disconnected, so a real socket alone proves nothing about field terminals.
recorded.prompt:q-client-from-descriptor:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-client-from-descriptor:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-client-from-descriptor:d: 11.4 shows the server reading a binary length as ASCII digits, logging Invalid message length and closing the connection, so it does not detect framing.
recorded.prompt:q-one-after-another:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-one-after-another:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-one-after-another:b: 11.5 shows a second session overwriting the first session's field, and 11.3 says participants live as long as the Q2, so participants are not created fresh for each purchase.
recorded.prompt:q-one-after-another:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-one-after-another:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-one-after-another:c: 11.5 makes the bug appear with only two transactions in flight, and requests sent one after another are not in flight together, so more writers are not needed.
recorded.prompt:q-one-after-another:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-one-after-another:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-one-after-another:d: 11.5 shows the second session writing the field the first session then read, so sessions share one field and do not each have their own.

gates.says: each of the 4 questions keys exactly 1 of its distinct options and every option carries the sentence its reader is shown
each of the 4 questions cites a passage the ledger still digests to the value this exercise was built from
